note: Shirt colours as API-Football sends them in team.colors, copied from the public live/ match files. These are API-Football's own colours, not ours. byId: per team id, the colours that team wore most often as the home side (any appearance when it never had colours at home). byName: Premier League and Champions League teams only, so a WSL side named like its men's club takes those colours. /scores/ uses this only when a match file has no colours of its own. Refresh: npm run team-colours, then commit.
